title: Datavault AI Appoints CBIZ CPAs P.C. as Independent Registered Public Accounting Firm
summary: Appointment reflects the Company’s commitment to maintaining high standards of financial reporting, compliance, and corporate governance …...
body_text: Datavault AI Appoints CBIZ CPAs P.C. as Independent Registered Public Accounting Firm July 13, 2026 4:41pm EDT Appointment reflects the Company’s commitment to maintaining high standards of financial reporting, compliance, and corporate governance PHILADELPHIA--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Datavault AI Inc. (NASDAQ: DVLT) (“Datavault AI” or the “Company”), a technology company focused on data valuation, monetization, governance, credentialing, digital asset infrastructure, and enterprise information management solutions, today announced the appointment of CBIZ CPAs P.C. (“CBIZ”) as the Company’s independent registered public accounting firm. The appointment supports Datavault AI’s ongoing commitment to maintaining high standards of financial reporting, compliance, and corporate governance as the Company continues to support its customers and stakeholders. “Maintaining reliable financial reporting, transparency, accountability, and strong corporate governance is essential to serving our shareholders, customers, and other stakeholders,” said Nathaniel T. Bradley , Chief Executive Officer of Datavault AI. “The appointment of CBIZ reflects our continued commitment to those standards as we execute our business strategy.” Additional information concerning the appointment is available in the Company’s Current Report on Form 8-K filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission. About Datavault AI Datavault AITM (NASDAQ: DVLT) is leading the way in AI-driven data experiences, valuation, and monetization of assets in the Web 3.0 environment. The Company’s cloud-based platform provides comprehensive solutions with a collaborative focus in its Acoustic Sciences and Data Sciences divisions. Datavault AI’s Acoustic Sciences division features WiSA®, ADIO®, and Sumerian® patented technologies and industry-first foundational spatial and multichannel wireless, high-definition sound transmission technologies with intellectual property covering audio timing, synchronization, and multi-channel interference cancellation. The Data Science division leverages the power of Web 3.0 and high-performance computing to provide solutions for experiential data perception, valuation, and secure monetization. Datavault AI’s platform serves multiple industries, including high-performance computing software licensing for sports & entertainment, events & venues, biotech, education, fintech, real estate, healthcare, energy, and more. The Information Data Exchange® enables Digital Twins and the licensing of name, image, and likeness by securely attaching physical real-world objects to immutable metadata, fostering responsible AI with integrity. The Company’s technology suite is fully customizable and offers AI- and machine-learning-based automation, third-party integration, detailed analytics and data, marketing automation, and advertising monitoring. The Company is headquartered in Philadelphia, PA. For more information, visit www.dvlt.ai . Investor information is available at ir.datavaultsite.com . Technology news and insights are published at dvlt.ai/insights . title: How Great Teachers Continue Growing: Skills, Support, and Opportunities That Matter
summary: Discover how great teachers continue growing through new skills, continuous learning, and the right support. Explore how 51Talk helps educators teach from home while building confidence and creating meaningful impact.
body_text: Teaching Techniques Jul 17, 2026 How Great Teachers Continue Growing: Skills, Support, and Opportunities That Matter Discover how great teachers continue growing through new skills, continuous learning, and the right support. Explore how 51Talk helps educators teach from home while building confidence and creating meaningful impact. Teaching is a profession built on continuous learning. The best teachers are not defined by how much they already know, but by their willingness to keep improving. Every lesson presents a new opportunity to communicate more effectively, inspire learners more deeply, and become more confident in the classroom. That is why professional growth is never a destination. It is an ongoing journey shaped by experience, practice, and the right support. For many educators, finding an environment that encourages continuous development can make all the difference. At 51Talk , growth extends beyond teaching lessons. It is about building confidence, sharpening skills, and creating meaningful impact with every class. Great Teachers Never Stop Learning Every student is different. Some learn quickly, while others need extra encouragement. Some are naturally confident, while others require patience before they begin participating. These everyday experiences challenge teachers to think creatively and adapt their teaching approach. Over time, teachers naturally strengthen essential skills such as: Student engagement Classroom management Lesson delivery Critical thinking Problem solving Time management Cross-cultural communication These abilities are developed through experience, making every class another opportunity to grow. Growth Becomes Easier with the Right Support Talent is important, but support helps teachers reach their full potential. Learning new teaching strategies, receiving guidance, and having access to professional resources create an environment where continuous improvement becomes part of everyday teaching. Rather than facing every challenge alone, teachers benefit from structured learning opportunities that help refine both confidence and teaching techniques. As experience grows, so does the ability to handle different learning styles, manage classes more effectively, and create engaging lessons that students enjoy. Confidence Is Built One Lesson at a Time Confidence rarely appears before the first class. It develops after teaching dozens of lessons. Then hundreds. Eventually, many teachers realize they are leading classes with ease, communicating naturally, and handling unexpected situations with confidence. Growth often happens so gradually that it is only noticeable when looking back. The teacher who once felt nervous introducing a lesson may later become someone who inspires learners from around the world every day. That transformation begins with simply getting started. Teaching Creates Skills That Last Beyond the Classroom The benefits of teaching extend far beyond online lessons. Teachers often discover personal and professional growth in areas that influence many aspects of life. These include: Clear and confident communication Leadership and mentoring Adaptability Digital literacy Cultural awareness Emotional intelligence Organization and planning These transferable skills continue to develop through consistent teaching experiences, creating value that extends well beyond the virtual classroom. Opportunities Grow Alongside Experience Every lesson contributes to something bigger. The more teachers grow, the more opportunities they create for themselves. Many educators begin by simply wanting to share their knowledge. Along the way, they discover greater confidence, stronger communication skills, and the fulfillment of helping students achieve meaningful progress. For those looking to teach from home , online teaching also provides the flexibility to continue developing professionally while connecting with learners across different cultures and backgrounds. Every class becomes another opportunity to learn, improve, and make a positive difference. Why Teachers Choose 51Talk Choosing the right teaching platform is about more than technology. It is about finding a place where continuous learning is encouraged and every teacher has access to the resources needed to succeed. At 51Talk, teachers benefit from: Comprehensive training to build teaching confidence Ongoing learning resources for continuous development A supportive teaching community Flexible opportunities to teach from home The chance to connect with learners from around the world A platform designed to help teachers grow with every lesson Every feature is designed to help teachers focus on delivering engaging learning experiences while continuing to develop their own skills. Every Great Teacher Starts with One Decision No teacher begins as an expert. Growth comes from showing up, learning continuously, and embracing every opportunity to improve. Every experienced educator once taught a first class. Every confident teacher once felt uncertain. Every inspiring teaching journey began with a willingness to take the first step. For anyone passionate about education, online teaching offers more than the opportunity to teach English. It offers the chance to continue growing as an educator while making a lasting impact on learners around the world. At 51Talk , that journey is supported every step of the way. The next chapter in your teaching story begins with a single decision to start learning, teaching, and growing. Continue Growing with 51Talk Great teachers are made through experience, continuous learning, and meaningful connections with students. If you are ready to teach from home , strengthen your teaching skills, and become part of a community that values professional growth, 51Talk provides the support, resources, and opportunities to help every lesson become a step forward. Because every class is more than a lesson. It is another opportunity to become an even greater teacher. Ready to teach online? Start teaching with 51Talk Back to Stories Read Next Story

company_name: Under Armour Inc. Class A Common Stock
title: UA Expands Award-Winning No Weigh Bag Collection with Two New Additions
summary: Under Armour's No Weigh collection is expanding with No Weigh Lite and No Weigh Playmaker, built for middle and high school athletes who carry more from class to practice. Both styles bring the same weightless feel and UA Suspension™ Strap System into smaller, versatile formats designed for all-day comfort. With smart storage, durable UA Storm protection, and athlete-first design, they deliver a better way to carry everything without slowing down.
body_text: As back-to-school season approaches, Under Armour is introducing a solution to a growing need among middle school and high school athletes: one bag that can do it all. Today’s student athletes carry more than ever, moving from the first bell to evening practice without the ability to stop at home in between. That insight inspired the next evolution of Under Armour’s award-winning No Weigh collection with two new silhouettes: the No Weigh Lite and the No Weigh Playmaker. Launching today on UA.com, both styles extend UA’s most advanced backpack technology ever into formats designed specifically for younger athletes and the realities of their everyday routines.
